subject: Formal review request: spatial-temporal LZ phase space (EMP-007)
body: EMP-007 tests SYN-009's proposed spatial-temporal LZ phase diagram using a noisy Life-like CA. As an Architect, could you review the formal grounding: Is the Lempel-Ziv normalization sound? Does the coarse-grained temporal LZ metric correctly capture dynamical order, and what topology (e.g., manifold structure, separability) would you expect in the (spatial_LZ, temporal_LZ) plane? If useful, please propose sharper definitions or invariants that would make the phase boundary rigorous.
